Definition: Whether the civil registration and digital ID systems are integrated
Comments: The national ID system is directly linked to civil registration. The 14-digit national number is assigned at birth registration and remains linked to the individual for life. The Civil Registry Authority (under Ministry of Interior) manages both birth/death/marriage registration and national ID issuance. The Department of Civil Registration was established in 1960; computerized ID introduced in 1995. Smart civil registry machines also dispense birth certificates using national ID authentication. The Unified National Registry (UNR) cross-references civil registration data.

Definition: Whether procedural rules for collection, storage, and sharing of ID-related personal data are publicly available and established
Comments: PDPL No. 151/2020 requires explicit consent for data processing and sharing; cross-border data transfer requires PDPC approval. The NTRA IoT framework requires institutional/technical measures to protect user data. Executive regulations issued December 2025 provide detailed data sharing rules. The framework is established but enforcement is still maturing.

Definition: Whether the system collects biometric data and which modalities are collected (fingerprints, facial image, iris scans)
Comments: The national ID card includes a personal photograph. Fingerprint-based authentication is used at civil registry self-service machines for document retrieval, and facial recognition is used in the MOIEG-PASS biometric app (pilot 2026) and the Haweya platform (face + fingerprint). The physical card itself does not carry a biometric chip. FRA Decree No. 140/2023 mandates biometrics (facial + fingerprint) for fintech digital ID processes. Comments: The Egyptian national ID card is recognized within Arab League countries for travel and identity verification purposes. Comments: Non-nationals (foreign residents) are required to register with GAPIN (General Administration of Passports, Immigration and Nationality) and obtain a residence permit card (separate from the Egyptian national ID).
